text: And YHWH spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first of the second month, in the second year of their going out from the land of Egypt, saying,
“Take a census of all the congregation of the sons of Israel by their clans, by the house of their fathers, by the number of names—every male by their polls.
From a son of twenty years and above, all who can go to war in Israel, you⁺ shall number them by their armies—you and Aaron;
and with you⁺ there shall be a man of every tribe; each one [is] the head of the house of his father.
And these [are] the names of the men who shall stand with you⁺: From Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur.
From Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
From Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab.
From Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar.
From Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon.
From the sons of Joseph: From Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud, from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.
From Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni.
From Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
From Asher, Pagiel son of Ocran.
From Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel.
From Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan.”
These were chosen from the congregation, leaders of the tribes of their fathers; they [were] the heads of thousands in Israel.
And Moses took Aaron and these men who had been mentioned by name,

and they assembled all the congregation on the first of the second month, and they recited their ancestry by clans, by the house of their fathers, by the number of names, from a son of twenty years and above, by their polls,
as YHWH had commanded Moses. And he numbered them in the Wilderness of Sinai.

And the sons of Reuben oldest son of Israel—their genealogies by their clans, by the house of their fathers, by the number of names individually, every male from a son of twenty years and above, everyone going out to the host—
those numbered of the tribe of Reuben [were] six and forty thousand and five hundred.

From the sons of Simeon, according to their genealogies, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, numbered by the number of names individually, every male from a son of twenty years and above, everyone going out to the host,
those numbered of the tribe of Simeon [were] nine and fifty thousand and three hundred.
From the sons of Gad, their genealogies, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, by the number of names, from a son of twenty years and above, everyone going out to the host,
those numbered of the tribe of Gad [were] five and forty thousand and six hundred and fifty.
From the sons of Judah, their genealogies, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, by the number of names, from a son of twenty years and above, everyone going out to the host,
those numbered of the tribe of Judah [were] four and seventy thousand and six hundred.
From the sons of Issachar, their genealogies, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, by the number of names, from a son of twenty years and above, everyone going out to the host,
those numbered of the tribe of Issachar [were] four and fifty thousand and four hundred.
From the sons of Zebulun, their genealogies, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, by the number of names, from a son of twenty years and above, everyone going out to the host,
those numbered of the tribe of Zebulun [were] seven and fifty thousand and four hundred.

From the sons of Joseph, the sons of Ephraim, their genealogies, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, by the number of names, from a son of twenty years and above, everyone going out to the host,
those numbered of the tribe of Ephraim [were] forty thousand and five hundred.
From the sons of Manasseh, their genealogies, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, by the number of names, from a son of twenty years and above, everyone going out to the host,
those numbered of the tribe of Manasseh [were] two and thirty thousand and two hundred.
From the sons of Benjamin, their genealogies, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, by the number of names, from a son of twenty years and above, everyone going out to the host,
those numbered of the tribe of Benjamin [were] five and thirty thousand and four hundred.
From the sons of Dan, their genealogies, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, by the number of names, from a son of twenty years and above, everyone going out to the host,
those numbered of the tribe of Dan [were] two and sixty thousand and seven hundred.
From the sons of Asher, their genealogies, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, by the number of names, from a son of twenty years and above, everyone going out to the host,
those numbered of the tribe of Asher [were] one and forty thousand and five hundred.
From the sons of Naphtali, their genealogies, by their clans, by the house of their fathers, by the number of names, from a son of twenty years and above, everyone going out to the host,
those numbered of the tribe of Naphtali [were] three and fifty thousand and four hundred.
These [are] the ones who were numbered, whom Moses numbered—and Aaron and the princes of Israel, twelve men—each one was for the house of his father.
And all who were numbered of the sons of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from a son of twenty years and above, everyone going out to the host in Israel,
even all who were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
And the Levites by the tribe of their fathers were not numbered in their midst,
for YHWH had spoken to Moses, saying,
“Only the tribe of Levi you shall not number, and a census of them you shall not take in the midst of the sons of Israel.

And you shall appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all things that belong to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings, and they shall attend to it, and around the tabernacle they shall camp.
And in the going forward of the tabernacle, the Levites shall take it down. And in the encamping of the tabernacle, the Levites shall set it up. And the outsider who comes near shall be put to death.
And the sons of Israel shall encamp, each man by his own camp, and each man by his own standard, by their hosts.

And the Levites shall camp around the tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may not be wrath on the congregation of the sons of Israel. And the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of the Testimony.”
And the sons of Israel did according to all that YHWH had commanded Moses; so they did.
